title: Single Molecule FISH Protocol
author: Thuc Nguyen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xb2fiqe
materials: Proceed to hybridization. See section above.

steps.title: Prepare and Silanize Coverslips
steps.instruction: Clean and functionalize coverslips to prepare them for tissue sectioning.

substeps.instruction: Clean Thorlabs #CG15KH coverslips with lens paper and 70% ethanol.
Load coverslips into a quartz or compatible plasma cleaning oven rack.
Form vacuum in the oven, turn on plasma, and clean for 30 mins.
Pipette 100 μl of 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APES, Sigma #A3648) onto a crumpled KimWipe and place next to coverslips in the oven.
Transfer coverslips to a vacuum dessicator, place another KimWipe with 100 μl of APES next to them, form vacuum, and let sit for 10 min.
Wash coverslips by moving them up and down 5 times in 100% methanol, then in fresh methanol, and allow to dry.
Store cleaned and silanized coverslips in a cool, dry, low-dust place.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue Sections
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the brain tissue and create thin sections on the prepared coverslips.

substeps.instruction: Place the frozen OCT block with embedded brain into a -20°C cryostat for 30 minutes to equilibrate.
Adhere silanized coverslips to glass slides by placing 10 μl of nuclease-free water onto a clean slide and placing the coverslip on top.
Using a cryostat, make 10-μm sections and pick them up on the pre-chilled silanized coverslips.
Let sections dry in the cryostat chamber for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Fix and Permeabilize Tissue
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue and remove lipids to allow probe penetration.

substeps.instruction: Immerse coverslips (attached to slides) in a slide rack in pre-chilled 4% PFA in PBS for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove coverslips from slides and place into a coverslip rack.
Wash 3x 5 mins with PBS.
Permeabilize with 100% methanol for 10 mins at -20°C.
Remove coverslips from methanol and let dry completely at room temperature.

steps.title: Store Processed Sections
steps.instruction: Store the fixed and permeabilized sections for future use.

substeps.instruction: Box coverslips into experimental sets (e.g., 2-6 per box).
Place each box into a zip lock bag, seal tight, and store at -80°C.
When ready for use, remove the box; do not return to the freezer once opened.

steps.title: Mount and Prepare for Hybridization
steps.instruction: Mount the sections in imaging chambers and remove lipids using SDS.

substeps.instruction: Remove coverslips from -80°C and place on a glass slide for support.
Trim SecureSeal chambers (Grace Bio-Labs #621502) to fit the ASI Imaging Chamber (or equivalent) and place around each section.
Perform all subsequent room temperature steps in a clean PCR hood (RNase-free area).
Slowly pipette 2X SSC into the chamber to push out air bubbles; equilibrate for 1 min (approx. 100 μl volume).
Pipette 200 μl of 8% SDS into the chamber and incubate for 10 mins at room temperature.
Hold the coverslip sideways over a beaker and pipette 500 μl of 2X SSC through the chamber. Repeat 4 more times (5 total) until the output is no longer soapy.

steps.title: Hybridization
steps.instruction: Equilibrate tissue and incubate with probes.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate tissue by pipetting 100 μl of Hybridization Buffer (10% formamide in 2X SSC with tRNA, RVC, and BSA) into the chamber for 5 mins.
Dilute probes in Hybridization Buffer to a final concentration of 2 ng/μl.
Pipette the probe mix into the SecureSeal chamber and cover ports with sealing stickers.
Place in a humidified chamber (e.g., pipette tip box with wet paper towels at the bottom, covered with a lid and Parafilm) and incubate for 2 hours at 37°C.

steps.title: Post-Hybridization Washing
steps.instruction: Remove unbound probes and apply DAPI.

substeps.instruction: Wash with Probe Wash Buffer (20% formamide in 2X SSC) containing 5 μg/ml DAPI for 10 mins at 37°C by pushing 500 μl through the chamber over a beaker.
Wash with Probe Wash Buffer (without DAPI) 2 x 10 min at 37°C, pushing 500 μl through each time.
Pipette 500 μl of 2X SSC through the chamber over a beaker; repeat once.

steps.title: Imaging and Final Stringency Washes
steps.instruction: Prepare for imaging or perform final stringency washes.

substeps.instruction: Add enzymes to Imaging Buffer and pipette into the SecureSeal chamber for immediate imaging.
To proceed to stringency washes, replace Imaging Buffer in the chamber with 2X SSC (Optional: store at 4°C overnight).
Add 65% formamide in 2X SSC to the chamber for 3x 10 mins at 37°C (or 30°C).
Wash with 2X SSC 3x 5 mins at room temperature by pipetting 500 μl through the chamber each time (Optional: store at 4°C overnight).
